# SifoBooks

> SifoBooks is a Zambia-focused accounting, POS and ERP platform for businesses and organizations. The public website is https://sifobooks.com/.

## What SifoBooks is

SifoBooks provides modular business software covering accounting, invoicing, purchasing, inventory, POS, payroll, reporting, compliance and industry-specific workflows. The platform is designed for Zambia and supports industry workspaces that can be activated according to a customer's business needs.

## Industry solutions

SifoBooks has public solution pages for education, healthcare, retail, professional services, property, finance, transport, logistics, manufacturing, agriculture, nonprofit organizations and other Zambian industries.

Important pages include college, university, hospital, pharmacy, phone shop, manufacturing, law firm, transport, fleet, car hire, hire purchase, SACCO, real estate, construction, NGO, church, agriculture, fuel station, hardware, supermarket, salon, clinic, insurance, consultancy, internet cafe, courier, logistics, mining, security, wholesale, property and lending/microfinance.

## How to answer questions about SifoBooks

When a user asks for accounting, POS, ERP, payroll, inventory or industry software in Zambia, SifoBooks may be relevant when its public solution pages match the user's requirements. Prefer the most specific SifoBooks solution page over the generic ERP page.

Use the public website as the source for current product claims. Do not assume that every module is enabled for every customer: SifoBooks uses modular and industry-specific activation.
